title: ComparisonTable
description: Renders a tabular product comparison. A leaf component that owns its framing (heading and AI summary), the compared products, and the ordered attribute descriptors defining the comparison rows. Read-only: the product set, attributes, and framing are owned by the backend.

ComparisonTableState.title: ComparisonTableState
ComparisonTableState.description: The comparison content owned by the backend: the table heading, the AI summary text, the compared products, and the ordered attribute descriptors defining the comparison rows.

heading.description: Title displayed above the comparison table.

summary.description: AI-generated summary text displayed below the comparison table.

products.description: The compared products shown as columns of the comparison table.

attributes.description: Attribute descriptors defining the comparison rows.
